jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.job_description: We are hiring a Backend Engineer (Python) to build and operate the services behind our recruitment-automation platform: FastAPI services, data-processing pipelines, document parsing, and LLM-based evaluation. Strong Python, REST/API design, testing (pytest) and CI experience expected; PDF/document processing and LLM integration are a plus.

criteria.name: Python & backend experience
criteria.description: Depth of professional Python and backend/API development experience.

criteria.name: API design & typing
criteria.description: REST API design, FastAPI, Pydantic/typing familiarity.

criteria.name: Testing & quality
criteria.description: Automated testing (pytest), CI, code review habits.

criteria.name: Document/LLM processing
criteria.description: Exposure to PDF/document processing and LLM/AI integration.

criteria.name: Communication & collaboration
criteria.description: Evidence of teamwork, communication, and cross-functional work.

jobs.title: Graphic Designer
jobs.job_description: We are hiring a Graphic/Product Designer to own visual and brand design across our product and marketing surfaces. We care about visual hierarchy, layout, and craft; fluency with Figma/Adobe tooling; a strong portfolio; and close collaboration with product and engineering. The CV itself is treated as a design artifact.

criteria.name: Visual hierarchy & layout
criteria.description: Quality of the CV's own visual hierarchy, layout, spacing, and section design — assessed from the page images, as a proxy for design craft.

criteria.name: Portfolio & design experience
criteria.description: Depth of product/visual design experience and portfolio evidence.

criteria.name: Tooling
criteria.description: Fluency with design tools (Figma, Sketch, Adobe CC) and prototyping.

criteria.name: Collaboration & communication
criteria.description: Evidence of cross-functional work with product/engineering and clear communication.

jobs.title: AI Agent intern
jobs.job_description: Role Summary - As an AI Agent Intern, you will work closely with our engineering and product teams to design, develop, and test large language model (LLM) powered agents. You will explore cutting-edge AI frameworks to automate complex tasks, build interactive digital assistants, and create smart pipelines that solve real-world problems for our users. Key Responsibilities - Design, build, and deploy autonomous AI agents using modern LLM frameworks. Write, refine, and optimize complex prompts to safely and effectively guide agent behavior. Integrate AI agents with external APIs, databases, and third-party software tools. Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to provide agents with accurate, domain-specific knowledge. Design evaluation metrics to test agent performance for accuracy, hallucination rates, and efficiency.Document code, workflows, and experimental findings to share knowledge with the broader engineering team. Required Qualifications Currently pursuing (or recently graduated with) a degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field. Strong proficiency in programming, specifically using Python or TypeScript. Solid conceptual understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI concepts. Familiarity with version control systems like Git and collaborative platforms like GitHub. Excellent problem-solving skills and a strong, self-driven desire to learn rapidly evolving technologies.

criterion_scores.evidence: Currently pursuing BSc (Hons) Data Science, University of Plymouth, 2024-2027 — an undergraduate in a directly relevant field.
Skills list: 'Python scripting, task automation'; 'Backend & APIs: Python, FastAPI, REST APIs'; multiple projects using FastAPI/Python (LinkAble Vision, EQUA-RESPONSE, SLSAW, ChurnOps).
EQUA-RESPONSE project 'using Next.js, TypeScript, Leaflet, Zustand, and FastAPI' — only one explicit mention of TypeScript usage.

evaluation.summary: The candidate is a Data Science undergraduate with strong, well-documented Python experience across multiple AI/backend projects, satisfying the core programming requirement. TypeScript is mentioned in one project (EQUA-RESPONSE) but not emphasized elsewhere, giving moderate but real evidence. Degree is in progress but clearly relevant to the role, making the candidate a solid overall match.
